Class OffscreenFiles

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.script.OffscreenFiles
public final class OffscreenFiles extends Object
General script file operations; all screen behavior stays in the calling script.

    • readText

      public static String readText(String path, String fallback) throws IOException
      Reads a small UTF-8 settings file synchronously. Missing files return the fallback.
      Parameters:
      path - caller-owned path
      fallback - value for absence
      Returns:
      decoded contents
      Throws:
      IOException - if reading fails

    • writeText

      public static void writeText(String path, String text) throws IOException
      Replaces a small UTF-8 settings document synchronously, using a temporary sibling.
      Parameters:
      path - caller-owned path
      text - complete new contents
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing fails

    • read

      public static OffscreenFiles.TextResult read(String path, String fallback)
      Reads text as data so languages without exception handling can display failures.
      Parameters:
      path - caller-owned file
      fallback - value for a missing file
      Returns:
      value/error result; no exception is hidden as a successful read

    • write

      public static OffscreenFiles.TextResult write(String path, String text)
      Writes text and reports the outcome as data for script-side validation messages.
      Parameters:
      path - caller-owned file
      text - complete new contents
      Returns:
      successful value or a failure description
